_comment: Single source of truth for bench boards and the firmware each one runs. Used by tools/flash.py. No MAC addresses: boards are recognized by the LocalGrid device ID stored on the board and answered by its serial 'id' command. Ports are hints and shift when boards are re-plugged.

ELG.description: Elegoo ESP32 dev board (CP2102, 4 MB flash, no PSRAM)

HY3.description: Hosyond 3.2in ESP32 display (ST7789P3 240x320, resistive touch, CH340, 4 MB flash)

F4B.description: Freenove FNK0104B 2.8in ESP32-S3 display (ILI9341, FT6336U touch, 16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM)

E28.description: LCDWIKI E32R28T-1 2.8in ESP32-32E display (ILI9341 240x320, XPT2046 touch on its own pins, DAC speaker, one USB-C, 4 MB flash)

CYD.description: ESP32-2432S028 2.8in 'CYD', dual-USB variant with the inverting panel (ILI9341 240x320, XPT2046 touch on its own pins, DAC speaker, no battery, 4 MB flash)

E40.description: LCDWIKI E32R40T 4.0in ESP32-32E display (ST7796 320x480, XPT2046 touch on the display bus, DAC speaker, one USB-C, 4 MB flash)

C6L.description: Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47 (ESP32-C6, ST7789 172x320, no touch, BOOT button, WS2812 LED, TF slot, native USB-Serial/JTAG, 4 or 8 MB flash, no PSRAM). Alert and distress unit (D66).

C6T.description: Waveshare ESP32-C6-Touch-LCD-1.47 (ESP32-C6FH8, JD9853 172x320, AXS5106L capacitive touch, QMI8658 IMU, battery sense on GPIO0, BOOT button, native USB-Serial/JTAG, 8 MB flash, no PSRAM). Alert and distress unit (D66).

node.description: Infrastructure node: SoftAP, TCP sessions, ESP-NOW backbone, BLE adverts, serial console. Node 0 also serves the admin page.

tests.description: On-board tests: lg_core unit tests, RFC crypto vectors, simulated three-node grid.

handheld.description: Handheld: joins the grid over Wi-Fi, registers with a node, and shows link, grid time, people, and nodes on screen.

devices.name: c6-alert
devices.notes: Waveshare ESP32-C6 1.47in alert and distress unit (D66), added 2026-09-18. Prototype roster user 'Handheld 7'. Its factory demo (RAM test, SD PNG search, BLE and Wi-Fi scans) is the plain board's, so it starts as C6L. The two Waveshare 1.47in C6 boards are wired differently; at boot the firmware probes for the Touch version's I2C parts and switches profile if it finds them (log: [BSP] Board probe). If it reports C6T, re-mint as C6T with --erase --new-id so the ID says what the board is. Set the port; the first flash mints its ID.
